objective: Prove that non-price activation evidence improves timing and extreme-winner capture beyond bottleneck discovery alone.

named_cases_policy.SNDK_PLTR: diagnostic after model freeze; never used to choose formulas or thresholds
named_cases_policy.promotion: complete blind universe is primary; named cases remain mandatory post-freeze diagnostics

hypotheses.H1: Bottleneck plus beneficiary/value capture identifies structural opportunity but not timing.
hypotheses.H2: Monetization or a dated catalyst plus an open expectations gap and supply-response lag increases the hazard of repricing within the stated horizon.
hypotheses.H3: Positioning/flow amplifies speed and magnitude but cannot create a thesis without origin and transmission.
hypotheses.H4: The repricing-ready state must outperform matched bottleneck-only dormant controls after sector, size, date, and liquidity matching.

design.controls: same sector/industry, date, size, liquidity, valuation availability, and listing age

capital_rule: Passing this protocol does not grant capital. Real costs, profit factor, drawdown, capacity, prospective trades, and signed review remain mandatory.
